name: Triple
author: Emilie Gillet
description: Three oscillators with two continuously swept interval knobs, morphing together through square, saw, triangle, and sine. It overlaps Chords and Swarm in territory, not lineage: intervals you sweep rather than a table you author.

controls.label: Spread
controls.description: Spreads the second voice through closely spaced and musical intervals.

controls.label: Interval
controls.description: Spreads the third voice independently of the second.

controls.label: Waveform
controls.description: Morphs all three voices from square through saw and triangle to sine.

controls.label: Shape
controls.description: Narrows the pulse and slope of all three voices below the stock symmetry.

outputs.aux: Undetuned root voice. The stereo toggle does not change this fixed mix/root pair.

trigger: Realigns all three oscillator phases so each triggered note starts alike.
upstream: Braids MacroOscillator::RenderTriple (square, saw, triangle, sine x3)
